question.text: When 300 J of heat given to an ideal gas with $C_{p}=\frac{7}{2} R$ its temperature raises from $20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ to $50^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ keeping its volume constant. The mass of the gas is (approximately) $\_\_\_\_$ g. $(\mathrm{R}=8.314 \mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{mol}. \mathrm{K})$
